thread:
sara (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount — asked to put the hiring signal and how teams get slots into this thread. TL;DR: no org-wide freeze, but prioritized buckets for Q4.
lee (Eng Manager): thanks! can you list the prioritized buckets? are infra + runtime first? :thinking:
taylor (Infra): we heard infra was prioritized — will that include oncall hires and SRE expansion or just runtime optimizations?
sara (People Ops): prioritized buckets we announced: 1) customer-facing product teams with clear runway to revenue 2) infra/runtime (latency/cost) 3) platform/observability tied to Dedicated/Private launches 4) critical security/compliance hires. oncall roles fall under infra/runtime if they're dedicated to production SLOs.
raj (Product): one question — how are open reqs routed if multiple teams ask? is there a central allocation or do managers negotiate internally?
sara (People Ops): good q. process: managers submit a short justification form (link in the all-hands deck). Hiring committee (People Ops + Eng leadership) scores requests against the buckets and impact metrics. committee may reassign slots if overlap — we try to keep transfers internal first.
lee (Eng Manager): what about internal transfers? if i have an IC who wants to move to product, does that compete with external reqs?
sara (People Ops): internal transfers are encouraged and do not always consume a new external slot if the org can backfill within its pool. ops-bot will annotate transfers in the hiring tracker.
ops-bot: [automated] note: hiring tracker updated — form submissions open until EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
taylor (Infra): timeline for approvals? we have a candidate in process waiting on an approved slot.
sara (People Ops): approvals target 7 business days after submission. if it's blocking a live offer, ping me directly and we'll fast-track.
michelle (CEO): adding context — this isn't about cutting teams, it's about being intentional with where we add headcount to hit our performance and go-to-market priorities. managers: be specific about impact in the form.
raj (Product): curious about banding — will we still keep hiring at the same seniority levels or shift toward more senior ICs to move faster?
sara (People Ops): banding remains flexible. committee recommends a mix but will prioritize senior hires for high-impact infra/product roles this quarter.
lee (Eng Manager): any changes to hiring manager approvals or interview panel expectations because of this?
sara (People Ops): interview panel expectations unchanged. small ask: add 1 question about measurable impact (metrics) to every loop. helps committees compare requests.
taylor (Infra): will Dedicated/Private sales commitments unlock extra slots for Platform hires?
michelle (CEO): yes — bookings that cross the quota threshold will auto-unlock dedicated hiring credits for the Platform org. finance will annotate in the tracker.
raj (Product): ok thanks. last one — org chart changes? some teams mentioned hub-based orgs in the Q&A.
sara (People Ops): leadership will publish a short org map next week showing hub owners and cross-functional pods. it's not a full reorg yet, more of an ownership map to reduce ambiguity.
lee (Eng Manager): appreciated. i'll review the form with my leads and submit.
michelle (CEO): thanks everyone — we'll keep this thread updated with tracker links and decisions. feel free to DM for urgent cases. :rocket:
